The attempted preimage-of-basic-open lemma timed out during elaboration and was preserved as a Horizon attempt artifact. No denominator cover, unit-rescaling bridge, overlap equality, or `glueMorphisms` consumer is claimed.

Hartshorne-scoped ledger status is clean. The shared ledger has since advanced to concurrent Milne commit `7f36b46f21`; unrelated Stacks, AJCR, dashboard, and control-plane paths remain outside this task and were not committed.

## Why I stopped

This is a clean one-shot checkpoint for the current bounded producer. The standing `fs-hartshorne` task remains running.
